rules: Never coerce unusual row labels such as 1W into numeric row 1.
Never generate missing rows to force continuous numbering.
Never infer seats-per-row for sections without verified seat counts.
Source-pack agreement must not be presented as independent public verification.
Seat identifiers and physical seat placement must expose separate verification states.
Keep ticket inventory separate from structural seat identifiers.
Modeled geometry and metrics must never be presented as architectural measurements.

unknownDoNotInfer: Exact railing heights and as-built rail profiles
Exact seats-per-row for all non-P234 MVP sections
Wheelchair and companion position counts inferred from W labels alone
Live ticket availability without a licensed provider
Exact vomitory widths and private suite interiors
